title: Metastable and critical-bubble branches of Coleman--Weinberg monopoles
summary: We revisit the Coleman--Weinberg monopole problem introduced by Kiselev, where radiative symmetry breaking makes the broken vacuum metastable. We construct the associated static monopole--critical-bubble configuration in the full coupled radial Higgs--gauge system and show that it is a saddle of the static energy functional. The metastable monopole and monopole--critical-bubble branches are characterized by their profiles, energies, and radial Hessian spectra.
